title: Ligature placement and a close mouthpiece
summary: Talk about how Hall puts on the ligature and the effect of a close lay with a soft reed.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: I noticed you put your ligature on the way Veneta told me to do it. Apparently some people put the screws on the other side.
Well, the reason I put mine on there is because usually when you get ready to put that cap on there, and if you're not using it, you'll mess your ears.
Yeah, that's right. For instance, here Benny Goodwin has his on up that way. Does it make much difference? No, I don't think so.
